newsitem.title: USA: Littlefield alters talks with Blumenfeld.
newsitem.headline: Littlefield alters talks with Blumenfeld.

text.p: Littlefield, Adams & Co said Thursday it was no longer discussing with Michael Blumenfeld a transaction outlined in a letter of intent dated May 1.
The company, which imprints and distributes athletic and leisure wear products, said it was nevertheless discussing other possible transactions with him.
"The company has not reached any agreement as to the terms of any such other possible transaction," it said.
The company did not elaborate and its officials were not immediately available for comment.
On May 5, Littlefield said the letter of intent would have it sell a 19.9-percent stake at $1.50 a share to Blumenfeld and make him chief executive officer upon the deal's closure.
It would also have given Blumenfeld the right to appoint the majority of the members of its board of directors.
Blumenfeld was the founder and chief executive of BSN Sports and Sport Supply Group Inc.
